title: AirPASS: Over-the-Air Federated Learning via Pinching Antenna Systems
abstract: arXiv:2607.06768v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper investigates over-the-air federated learning (AirFL) in wireless systems where the access point is equipped with a multi-waveguide pinching antenna system (PASS). We adopt the widely studied learning-oriented AirFL formulation, which seeks to maximize the number of selected devices while keeping the aggregation distortion below a prescribed threshold. The resulting joint optimization of device selection, receive beamforming, and pinching-antenna placement is highly nonconvex due to the intricate coupling among these system variables. To address this challenge, we develop AirPASS, an alternating optimization framework with two main components: a homotopy-Riemannian margin-consolidation method for device selection and receive beamforming under a fixed PASS configuration, and a homotopy-assisted geometry optimization method for updating the pinching-antenna positions under fixed selected devices and beamformer.

translated_title: AirPASS：基于夹持天线系统的空中联邦学习
translated_abstract: 本文研究了接入点配备多波导夹持天线系统（PASS）的无线系统中的空中联邦学习（AirFL）。我们采用被广泛研究的面向学习的AirFL建模方式，其目标是在将聚合失真控制在预定阈值之下的同时，最大化被选择设备的数量。由此产生的设备选择、接收波束成形与夹持天线位置的联合优化问题，由于这些系统变量之间复杂的耦合关系而呈现高度非凸性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了AirPASS——一个交替优化框架，包含两个核心组件：在固定PASS配置下，用于设备选择与接收波束成形的同伦-黎曼裕度巩固方法；以及在固定被选设备与波束成形器下，用于更新夹持天线位置的同伦辅助几何优化方法。
tldr: 本文提出AirPASS交替优化框架，通过同伦-黎曼裕度巩固方法与同伦辅助几何优化方法交替求解设备选择、接收波束成形和夹持天线位置的联合非凸优化问题，在夹持天线系统辅助的空中联邦学习中实现聚合失真阈值约束下的设备接入数量最大化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AirPASS, an alternating optimization framework that combines a homotopy-Riemannian margin-consolidation method and a homotopy-assisted geometry optimization method to jointly tackle the highly nonconvex problem of device selection, receive beamforming, and pinching-antenna placement for over-the-air federated learning with multi-waveguide pinching antenna systems.
